details:
Q1: Which consolidator OpenCode runs should move off the host into a fresh, credential-free, read-only sandbox?
Choices:
A: Every consolidator OpenCode run: the fallback after Claude is unavailable (exit 75, or the sandbox is missing) and the main path when the role resolves to codex/OpenCode. If isolation can't be set up, skip the consolidator with empty output, as its contract already allows. This matches how the review-blocked judge and conflict resolver already work. (RECOMMENDED)
B: Only the fallback after Claude is unavailable (lines 619-628), as the issue literally says. The codex-selected main path keeps running on the host.
C: Same as A, but if isolation can't be set up, fail the review step instead of skipping the consolidator. **Note:** this breaks the documented "the consolidator never gates" contract in agents.md, and that contract text and its tests would need to change.
